purpose: Local sales are an exception to the export business and must be separately monitored and controlled without ever preventing Accounts from recording an actual transaction.
calculation: recognized Pakistan local sales / recognized Pakistan export sales * 100

scope.note: TG customer turnover and Pakistan/TG intercompany revenue are excluded from the denominator. Scope remains configurable if auditors advise an entity-specific statutory calculation.

controls.rule: Accounts must always be able to post a real completed sale. Breaches are controlled through alarms, exception reporting, audit trail and prospective operational approvals, not by suppressing or blocking accounting recognition.
